title: erigeron acris var. racemosus
intro: Erigeron acris var. racemosus, commonly known as Alpine Fleabane, is a perennial plant species within the daisy family (Asteraceae) native to high-altitude regions of the Himalayas. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to treat digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin conditions, making it a potential remedy for various health concerns. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Fleabane are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can soothe and protect the body from external stressors. The bioactive constituents of Erigeron acris var. racemosus include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
